scope: Isolated synthetic backup and restore validation; no hosted resource reads, credentials, writes or deployments

warnings: Upstream starlette.testclient references the deprecated anyio.abc.BlockingPortal alias

execution_environment.postgres_scope: Loopback-only, unique pilot_backup_* databases, removed by fixture cleanup
execution_environment.object_storage: Injected in-memory S3 test double; no AWS endpoint
execution_environment.identities: Ephemeral synthetic age identities; no production credential generation
execution_environment.socket_access: Tests require the local loopback socket capability; a sandbox-only attempt passed 43 cases and had 4 connection setup errors before the successful permitted rerun

verified: A completion marker is written only after encrypted payload verification
All object references pin key, VersionId, SHA-256 and size
Restore uses the independently approved completion marker version even if the current object changes
Missing or mismatched marker checksum fails before restoring the database
Concurrent database writes are excluded consistently from both exported-snapshot digests and pg_dump
A later committed PostgreSQL write is preserved by a second fresh checkpoint and restored into another empty database
An unchanged proof photo is downloaded from the source only once across successive checkpoints
Real age encryption and authenticated decryption preserve synthetic bytes and reject corrupted ciphertext
Every restored application table digest, proof relationship, saved photo hash and usable ID sequence matches the checkpoint
Corrupted photo ciphertext prevents database restoration and success receipt creation
Live source database name, existing recovery paths, symlink ancestors, occupied targets and PostgreSQL connection overrides are refused
Read-only PostgreSQL backup role successfully dumps the dataset and cannot update an order even after requesting a read-write transaction
Missing, stale or future completion timestamps fail the freshness/retention checks
Hourly freshness fetches exactly one newest completion marker after paginated listing, and fails without fallback if that marker is malformed, stale or bound to another ID
Backup source port must match explicit configuration before any object-store call
Actual source and backup bucket locations must match us-west-2; a different or null region is refused before payload access or writes
Retention selects the newest checkpoint in 7 distinct UTC days, 4 ISO weeks and 3 calendar months
Retention removes only expired checkpoint marker/dump/manifest versions and never deletes encrypted photo archives
Missing retained payloads stop pruning before any deletion
Failure exit codes do not expose driver exception secrets or customer row values
IAM preparation separates runtime photos, archive writer, monitor, retention and recovery read permissions
not_verified: Actual AWS account, IAM policy authorization, bucket policy enforcement or cloud object durability
Render scheduled execution, cron environment or hosted resource limits
Actual failure and missed-backup notification delivery
A hosted scheduled checkpoint restored into an approved empty PostgreSQL target and private recovery photo bucket
Production-size memory use or recovery duration
Physical iPhone photo capture, selection or history retrieval
